title: UDTAB
body:
# UDTAB

UDTAB is a Bukkit-compatible Minecraft plugin for per-world scoreboards and tab headers/footers.

## Server Support

- Main target: Purpur
- Also supports: Paper, Folia, Spigot
- Minecraft target: 1.21+ using Bukkit/Spigot-compatible APIs
- Java: 17+ to build, Java 21+ recommended for running modern Minecraft servers

The plugin uses only standard Bukkit APIs for scoreboards and tab text. Folia scheduling is detected at runtime through reflection.

## Commands

- `/udtab reload` - reloads `config.yml`
- `/udtab apply` - reapplies the current world profile to yourself

## Permissions

- `udtab.admin` - allows all admin commands
- `udtab.reload` - allows `/udtab reload`
- `udtab.apply` - allows `/udtab apply`

## Configuration

Edit `src/main/resources/config.yml` before building, or edit `plugins/UDTAB/config.yml` after first server start.

Profiles are checked from top to bottom. The first profile with the player's current world in `worlds` is applied. Use `*` as a fallback.
